name: The Environment
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the earth and all that is within it, entrusting mankind with the responsibility to steward and care for His creation. In Genesis, humanity is commanded to replenish the earth and exercise dominion over living creatures, while also being placed in the Garden of Eden to tend and keep it. The Bible affirms God's sovereign preservation of all creation and models a life that finds blessing in walking apart from ungodliness, resting in the provision of green pastures and still waters as signs of His sustaining care.
